Class.summary: Controller responsible for administrative user management operations including searching, provisioning, updating, and querying user profiles.
Class.remarks: All endpoints in this controller require authentication and the Admin role. All validation errors and exceptions conform to the RFC 7807 ProblemDetails standard.

Constructor.summary: Initializes a new instance of the class.
Constructor.param: The MediatR mediator instance used for dispatching user queries and commands.

GetUsers.summary: Retrieves a paginated and filterable list of all registered users in the system.
GetUsers.remarks: Restricted to users in the Admin role. Role Filter: Optional filter by user role: Admin (0), SupportAgent (1), Customer (2). Search: Optional substring search matching against user display name or email address. Pagination: Page >= 1 (defaults to 1); PageSize between 1 and 100 (defaults to 10).
GetUsers.param: The query parameters including pagination options, optional role filter, and search keyword.
GetUsers.returns: A paginated collection of user summary DTOs, total records count, and pagination metadata.
GetUsers.response: Returns the paginated list of users matching the filter criteria.
If pagination or query parameters fail validation (e.g., page < 1, pageSize outside 1..100, invalid role enum).
If the request lacks a valid Bearer token.
If the caller does not have the Admin role.

GetUserById.summary: Retrieves the profile details of a specific user by their unique identifier.
GetUserById.remarks: Restricted to users in the Admin role. Returns the user's ID, email address, display name, assigned role, active status, and account creation timestamp.
GetUserById.param: The unique identifier (GUID) of the target user.
GetUserById.response: Returns the detailed profile of the requested user.
If the provided ID is not a valid GUID format.
If the request lacks a valid Bearer token.
If the caller does not have the Admin role.
If a user with the specified ID does not exist.

CreateUser.summary: Creates and provisions a new user account with a specified role.
CreateUser.remarks: Restricted to users in the Admin role. Administrators can provision Admin, SupportAgent, or Customer accounts. EmailConfirmed is automatically set to true for admin-created accounts. Enforces Identity password complexity rules and uniqueness of email address. Response includes a Location header pointing to GET /api/v1/users/{id}.
CreateUser.param: User creation command containing email, display name, temporary password, and assigned role.
CreateUser.returns: The newly created user profile response DTO.
CreateUser.response: User account was created successfully. Location header contains resource URI.
If input payload fails validation (e.g., invalid email, password under 8 characters, or unrecognized role).
If the request lacks a valid Bearer token.
If the caller does not have the Admin role.
If an account with the specified email address already exists.

UpdateUser.summary: Updates the profile information and active status of an existing user account.
UpdateUser.remarks: Restricted to users in the Admin role. Allows updating the user's DisplayName (up to 100 characters). Allows enabling or disabling the account by toggling IsActive (soft deletion). Deactivated users cannot log in.
UpdateUser.param: The unique identifier (GUID) of the user to update.
The update payload containing the new display name and desired active status.
UpdateUser.returns: The updated user profile response DTO.
UpdateUser.response: The user profile was updated successfully.
If the update payload fails validation (e.g., blank display name or name exceeding 100 characters).
If the request lacks a valid Bearer token.
If the caller does not have the Admin role.
If a user with the specified ID does not exist.

GetAgents.summary: Retrieves a paginated list of active Support Agents for ticket assignment.
GetAgents.remarks: Restricted to users in the Admin role. Returns active users holding the SupportAgent role, suitable for populating agent assignment dropdowns and managing workload distribution.
GetAgents.param: The 1-based page index (defaults to 1, must be >= 1).
The number of agents per page (defaults to 10, between 1 and 100).
GetAgents.returns: A paginated collection of support agent profiles and pagination metadata.
GetAgents.response: Returns the paginated list of support agents.
If pagination parameters fail validation (e.g., pageNumber < 1, pageSize outside 1..100).
If the request lacks a valid Bearer token.
If the caller does not have the Admin role.
